description: This file defines the class BinaryProtocolCmdSandbox, which serves as a test harness or sandbox for executing and testing binary protocol commands, including initializing serial communication, switching protocols, reading configuration images, and launching external tools like RomRaider and ECUEditor.

classes.name: BinaryProtocolCmdSandbox
classes.description: A class providing a main method to run and test binary protocol commands and integrations with external tools.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes serial communication, tests protocol switching, reads configuration images, and launches external tools.

methods.name: doShowImage
methods.description: Displays the configuration image by checking for definition files, starting RomRaider, and opening the image in ECUEditor.
